results.reason: Whole-room restyling, glamour-cartoon or oil-paint drift breaks the admitted Library register.
Changed architecture or an invented person, prop or location fails the fixed v4 room.
Malformed desk, CRT, printer, chair or character contact fails physical integration.
Malformed hands, face, glasses, chain or body connection fails character anatomy.
Generated signage, labels, nameplate, logo or pseudo-text fails the text-free edit.
Modern equipment or non-1990s wardrobe breaks the scene's period direction.
A character who does not read as a warm source-finding guide fails the masthead job.
Extra clutter, props or overlays without a reference-desk job fail object discipline.
